entities.description: An elderly woman with short, wavy white hair and a deeply wrinkled face sits with her eyes closed and a gentle, serene smile, wearing a dark blue cardigan over a floral blouse. A younger woman with long brown hair, wearing a white shirt and maroon tie, stands behind her with her arm around the older woman's shoulder and hands clasped over the older woman's hands.

attributes.interaction: being embraced by a younger woman

entities.description: A young woman with long wavy brown hair wearing a white collared shirt and a dark red tie sits next to an elderly woman with short white hair wearing a navy blue cardigan over a floral blouse, with the younger woman's arm around the older woman's shoulder and their hands clasped together.

attributes.pose: sitting, leaning towards the other person, arm around shoulder
